description: A schema (the app shows it to the person as a topic) and its versions, newest last, with every field (key, label, meaning, type, required, enumValues, auto, format, aliases). list_tracks gives each track's schemaId. Only its author can publish new versions: the person's own (mine) with publish_schema; anyone else's, TrackerHacker's included, can be forked under a new id.
name: get_schema
title: Get a schema
